subject: english
title: Read it aloud
parent_tip: Let your child read the story aloud while you time it. Help with a hard word, then let them go on. Read the questions together.

items.title: The Robin
items.text: Mia sees a robin in the maple tree. It has a red chest, and it sings a cheerful song. Mia sits very still and quiet because she wants to listen. After a few minutes, the robin flies down to the grass. It pulls a long worm out of the dirt. Then it carries the worm back to its nest.

items.q: What does the robin pull out of the dirt?
